violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Please enroll employee in a food safety manager course and email inspector proof. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026

Empanadas packaged in the food establishment are lacking label information including but not limited to subingredients and allergens. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Firm must not sell or distribute empanadas until labels are corrected and emailed to inspector for review. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026
